units.source_text: 她就在薰大将到她房中来谈话时，乘便把僧都的话告诉了他。

en.t: When Captain Kaoru came to her room to talk, she took the opportunity to tell him what the bishop had said.

units.source_text: 薰大将觉得此事离奇古怪，安得不大吃一惊呢？

en.t: Captain Kaoru found the matter so strange and uncanny that he could not help being deeply startled.

units.source_text: 他想：“前天皇后问我浮舟的情况，大概也已约略闻知此事了吧。

en.t: He thought, “When the Empress asked me about Ukifune the other day, she must already have heard something of this.”

units.source_text: 她为什么不详细告诉我呢？

en.t: Why did she not tell me the details?

units.source_text: 未免可恨。

en.t: It is rather vexing.

units.source_text: 但我也不曾把浮舟之事对她从头细说，却也难怪她了。

en.t: But since I never told her the whole story of Ukifune from the beginning, I suppose I cannot blame her.

units.source_text: 我当时听见浮舟失踪之后，觉得此事难听，所以绝不透露出去。

en.t: At the time, after hearing that Ukifune had disappeared, I thought the matter discreditable and never let it out.

units.source_text: 岂知外面反而纷纷传说了。

en.t: Who would have thought that people outside were spreading all kinds of rumors about it instead?

units.source_text: 这世间即使是活着的人有了秘密之事，也难于隐瞒。

en.t: In this world, even the secrets of the living are hard to keep hidden.

units.source_text: 何况已死之人的事，人家当然更无所顾忌地传说了。”

en.t: How much more freely, then, will people gossip without restraint about someone who is dead?”

units.source_text: 他觉得对这小宰相君，也不好意思把所有的情况全部告知，只是说道：

en.t: He felt too embarrassed to tell Little Captain Saisho everything, and merely said:

units.source_text: “照这话看来，这人的模样和我所认为死得奇怪的人非常相像呢。

en.t: “From what you say, this person sounds very much like someone whose strange death I have been wondering about.

units.source_text: 现在这人还住在那边么？”

en.t: Is that person still living over there now?”

units.source_text: 小宰相君答道：

en.t: Little Captain Saisho replied:

units.source_text: “那僧都下山那一天，已经给她剃度为尼了。

en.t: “On the day that bishop came down from the mountain, he had already shaved her head and made her a nun.

units.source_text: 她以前患重病之时，早就想出家，旁人认为可惜，劝阻了她。

en.t: When she was gravely ill before, she had long wished to take vows, but those around her thought it a pity and dissuaded her.

units.source_text: 但她本人学道之心非常坚决，终于出了家。”

en.t: But her own resolve to follow the Way was very firm, and in the end she entered religious life.”

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：

en.t: Captain Kaoru thought:

units.source_text: “地方同是宇治。

en.t: “The place is the same Uji.

units.source_text: 想想前后情状，此人与浮舟更无不同之点。

en.t: When I consider all the circumstances, there is nothing at all to distinguish this person from Ukifune.

units.source_text: 如果把她找到，认明确是本人，真是意想不到的怪事了！

en.t: If I found her and confirmed that she truly was Ukifune, it would be an astonishing and unexpected marvel.

units.source_text: 惟听人传说，岂可确信？

en.t: But how can I be certain from hearsay alone?

units.source_text: 但倘由我亲自特地去寻找，深恐外人将讥笑我乖戾。

en.t: Yet if I personally went out of my way to search for her, I fear people would mock me as perverse.

units.source_text: 还有，匂亲王倘亦已闻知，势必想起往事，去妨碍她求道的诚心。

en.t: Besides, if Prince Niou has also heard of it, he will surely recall the past and interfere with her sincere pursuit of the Way.

units.source_text: 也许他已有计划，特地关照明石皇后勿对我说，所以明石皇后听到了这等稀奇的事，

en.t: Perhaps he has already made some plan and deliberately asked Empress Akashi not to tell me, so even after hearing such a strange story,

units.source_text: 在我面前绝不谈起。

en.t: she never mentions it in my presence.

units.source_text: 如果明石皇后也已参与他的计划，那么我虽然非常怜爱浮舟，还不如只当她已经死去，从此断绝吧。

en.t: If Empress Akashi is also involved in his plan, then although I dearly pity Ukifune, I had better simply regard her as dead and break with her from now on.

units.source_text: 只要她还活着，那么将来到了黄泉路上，也许自有相逢的机会。

en.t: So long as she is still alive, perhaps there will be a chance for us to meet someday on the road to the underworld.

units.source_text: 但那时我决不会再动念头要把她据为己有了。”

en.t: But even then, I will never again think of trying to make her mine.”

units.source_text: 他左思右想，心绪缭乱。

en.t: He turned the matter over and over in his mind, his thoughts in turmoil.

units.source_text: 他料想明石皇后不会把此事告诉他，但想探察她的神色，便找个机会，

en.t: He expected that Empress Akashi would not tell him about it, but wanting to read her expression, he found an opportunity

units.source_text: 对明石皇后说道：

en.t: and said to Empress Akashi:

units.source_text: “有人告诉我：我所认为死得奇怪的那女子，并不曾死，流落在世间呢！

en.t: “Someone told me that the woman I believed had died so strangely did not die after all, but is wandering somewhere in the world.

units.source_text: 我很诧异，怎么会有这种事？

en.t: I was greatly astonished. How could such a thing be possible?

units.source_text: 然而我也一直在想：此女素性怯弱，

en.t: And yet I had always thought that this woman was timid by nature,

units.source_text: 似乎不会自己下决心干这种可怕的投河自尽、抛弃人世之事。

en.t: and did not seem like someone who would resolve on her own to do the fearful thing of throwing herself into the river and abandoning the world.

units.source_text: 照那人所说的模样，她似乎是被鬼怪摄去的。

en.t: From the way that person described her, it seemed as though she had been carried off by a spirit.

units.source_text: 也许确是如此吧。”

en.t: Perhaps that really was what happened.”

units.source_text: 便把浮舟的情况稍稍详细地告诉她。

en.t: He then told her somewhat more fully about Ukifune’s circumstances.

units.source_text: 关于匂亲王之事，他说得很客气，并不表示怨恨：

en.t: As for Prince Niou, he spoke very politely and showed no resentment:

units.source_text: “匂亲王如果闻知我又探悉了这女子的下落，将以我为顽劣的好色之徒吧。

en.t: “If Prince Niou hears that I have once again discovered this woman’s whereabouts, he will probably think me a stubborn and lecherous fellow.

units.source_text: 所以我要装作并不知道此事。”

en.t: So I intend to pretend that I know nothing about it.”

units.source_text: 明石皇后说道：

en.t: Empress Akashi said:

units.source_text: “那僧都说起此事之时，正是阴暗可怕的夜间，所以我没有仔细听他说。

en.t: “When that bishop spoke of the matter, it was on a dark and frightening night, so I did not listen to him closely.

units.source_text: 匂亲王怎么会闻知呢！

en.t: How could Prince Niou possibly have heard of it?

units.source_text: 我听了别人所说，觉得匂亲王习性实在不好。

en.t: From what I have heard others say, I think Prince Niou’s habits are truly poor.

units.source_text: 此事如果被他得知，那就更多麻烦了。

en.t: If this matter became known to him, it would cause even more trouble.

units.source_text: 世人都说他在男女恋情方面行为轻率可厌。

en.t: Everyone says that in affairs between men and women, his conduct is frivolous and unpleasant.

units.source_text: 我实在很替他担心呢。”

en.t: I truly worry about him.”

units.source_text: 薰大将觉得明石皇后性行实甚稳重，无论什么秘密事情，

en.t: Captain Kaoru felt that Empress Akashi’s character and conduct were truly steady, and that no matter what secret matter

units.source_text: 人家私下告诉她的，她决不泄露出去，他就放心了。

en.t: someone told her in private, she would never reveal it, and so he felt relieved.
